acceptanceCriteria: A test drives CAL-V0-074 worker recovery from STOPPING with usage known and a non-NO_EXEC result class; it fails on base with MALFORMED and passes after the fix.
The recovered program records usage unobserved without changing token counters or turns, matching CAL-V0-210.
Spec text for CAL-V0-074 states the usage rule.
body: Found by the independent review of V1-0795 (branch claude/v1-0795-lane, base 29cc7fd4), confirmed by source tracing, not reproduced dynamically. internal/tasks/store/program.go:69 settles a CAL-V0-074 worker recovery from STOPPING to FINISHED/PROVED but preserves UsageKnown. The recovery supplies no host output, so when usage was known and ResultClass is not NO_EXEC, internal/tasks/transaction/program.go:142 rejects the move as MALFORMED ('usage must derive from retained host output'). V1-0795's CAL-V0-210 usage correction records usage unobserved only on the new no-worker takeover branch and explicitly excludes this worker-recovery branch. Expected: a proved-stop worker recovery records usage unobserved (or carries retained host output) and is admitted. Actual: a valid recovery is refused, leaving the program STOPPING.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#740 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/740), merged to main at 36f0089a605aaaed2fe0acaf2928f38be263ece5. CAL-V0-074 worker recovery from STOPPING with non-NO_EXEC result records usageKnown=false, counters/turns unchanged (matches CAL-V0-210). Failing-before test TestCALV0074_WorkerRecoveryFromStopping (MALFORMED on base 64b5d174, passes with fix, -race). Spec text amended under decision 0493. Independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log at the merge commit.

title: tasks: CAL-V0-074 worker recovery from STOPPING keeps usage known and is refused MALFORMED for non-NO_EXEC results
